name: E3-standard starship lifeboat
description: The E3-standard starship lifeboat, or simply the E3 Escape Pod, was a type of escape pod manufactured by His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate. Grand Master Yoda used one in his journey to the planet Dagobah to live in exile after the rise of the Galactic Empire.
